title: Visualize grouped supplier aging invoice counts
description: A purchasing user sees a page-only count distribution in the existing dynamic supplier-aging field designer and can change grouping without changing report permissions or the static workspace. Development only; reuse ERP-140 authorized, bounded read-only supplier-aging preview and existing HTTP audit. Work solely on the current page. Preserve explicit unknown due dates, invalid/unknown allocation evidence, draft/void separation and currency isolation. Missing permission or invalid grouping fails closed. No new schema, migration, production SQL, real database execution, payment action, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Designer offers only ERP-144 catalog grouping keys and sends the selected key with the existing authorized bounded preview request.
Chart renders labeled invoice counts for supplier, currency, aging bucket and allocation status, including unknown classes, empty pages and pagination changes without unsafe HTML.
Node tests cover grouping selection, count chart text, unknown and empty groups, permission and network failures; document that counts are current-page evidence only.
